provenance: Complete JSON OCPP frames parsed from the charger existing LOG7628 export. Actual WS->/WS<- log records, not reconstructed LAN history. Sanitized and reserialized; NOT byte-for-byte wire capture. Raw original archive is retained privately.

transforms.request_ids: Consistent aliases preserving observed numeric-string19/hex-string32 shapes.
transforms.transaction_ids: Consistent synthetic integer aliases across standard and embedded JSON messages.
transforms.id_tags: Consistent synthetic aliases preserving observed tag lengths; no actual tag values.
transforms.timestamps: All ISO timestamps shifted by one constant; earliest becomes 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z. Relative durations preserved.
transforms.energy_registers: A common whole-kWh counter offset is applied to Wh start/stop meters and kWh/Wh energy samples; delivered deltas and original types/units preserved.
transforms.private_fields: Serial/QR/configuration identities, tags, URLs, filenames, secrets and nonempty free-form status info replaced.
transforms.embedded_json: JSON-string data remains a JSON string; explicit ids are aliased and data is reserialized.
